_doc: Shared fixtures for the Content Cadence keyword-first rules (SCHEDULING_KEYWORDS_PLAN.md §5.1, §5.5, §5.7, §9 KF, §14). Both suites run every case: the engine harness through the real Cadence Plan node (harness/scenarios_keyword_first.js) and the app mirror (app/server/src/services/cadence.ts, its tests). Language-neutral and self-contained: every row a case needs is in `tables`, every time is absolute, and `now` is the clock to freeze. Tables are the Data Tables the cadence loads: sites=seo_sites, cadence=seo_cadence, ladders=seo_ladders, ladder_settings=seo_ladder_settings (the `_site` row carries autopilot_level; empty = 2), content_log=seo_content_log, query_history=seo_query_history, trends=seo_trends, pages=seo_pages, ai_targets=seo_ai_targets (status queued), skips=seo_skips, monitors=seo_monitors. `trigger` is the Manual Run input ({} = the batch run; trigger "cycle" = the Cycle Dispatcher, with cycle_key and scheduled_for; preview true = the 48-hour "Coming up" plan). `level` is the effective autopilot level. expect.picks: the pages written, in order (keyword + source); expect.suggestions: the suggestions, in order; expect.waiting_for_keyword: the R-K2 status; expect.refused: every fit-gate refusal (keyword + reason), any order. Optional: expect.items (a preview plan, with auto), expect.awaiting (keywords waiting for approval), expect.skipped (item keys the client skipped), expect.budget_spent (R-K7: pages already spent in the cycle), expect.approved_not_written (the approvals not written in this run, each with its reason: pileup | budget | covered_by_live_page). The fit gate is the engine's fitGate (v5/code/_fit_gate.js): an app mirror must apply the same rules or call it. F-KW (2026-10-20): cycle_jobs = seo_cycle_jobs (the content_cadence jobs of earlier cycles: when the previous cadence ran, for R-K7 ladder starts); seo_ladders rows may carry chosen_by (the chooser when the settings row has none); seo_ladder_settings rows may carry rechecked_at (the app's passed re-check of a ladder planned 60+ days ago); seo_skips approve rows may carry source and ladder_id (the item the approval is for); sites may carry nav_pages_json (main menu pages, never rewritten on their own). "In topic" (automatic items) = the heads and kept rungs of the client's own ladders (not paused or archived) and the declared services; at level 3 also the crawled services; positive evidence is required at every level. A preview is judged at its scheduled_for. Optional expect.awaiting lists recheck items too.
